name: Sparse Voxel Octree Raycasting
definition: A hierarchical raycasting algorithm for Sparse Voxel Octrees that traverses from the highest layer down to leaf nodes to detect occluded voxels and compute hit points, handling arbitrary ray directions via axis-aligned coordinate transformation.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Raycasting is a hierarchical algorithm that efficiently intersects rays with sparse voxel data by skipping empty space and using coordinate reflection to handle arbitrary directions.
